questions.prompt: In circuit switching, the path stays reserved for the whole conversation, even while nobody is talking.
Fill in the blank: computers send data in short ______ separated by long silences, which is why a reserved circuit wastes capacity. (one word)
A switch in the middle of the path fails during a conversation. What happens?
options: Both kinds of network drop the conversation
On a circuit-switched network the conversation drops; on a packet-switched network traffic is routed around the failure
On a packet-switched network the conversation drops; on a circuit-switched network a backup circuit takes over
Neither notices, because switches don't fail

questions.prompt: Packets that belong to the same message always follow the same route.
What price does packet switching pay for sharing links?
options: Every conversation needs its own wire
Packets can be delayed, lost, or arrive out of order, so the endpoints have to cope
Only one computer can send at a time
It can't carry voice at all

questions.prompt: Which network was a US military message-switching system that stored whole messages at relay centers and then forwarded them?
DECnet was designed to connect computers from any vendor.
What's the word for a network of networks: separate networks joined so any host can reach any other? (one word)
Which of these is NOT one of the reasons to network given in the reading?
options: Sharing resources, like an expensive printer or computer
Sharing information, like files and email
Reliability: work can move to another machine if one fails
Making each computer run its own programs faster
